**HIP’S & TRICK’S COUPLES YOGA** 

Grab your special person and get ready for a Halloween-inspire couple yoga event

About this Event

🎃💜 HIP’S & TRICK’S COUPLES YOGA 💜🎃
Presented by Fit Like Mom LLC
Grab your special person and get ready for a Halloween-inspired couples yoga experience filled with movement, connection, laughter, intimacy, and a little extra sexy!
On October 30th at 7:00 PM, Fit Like Mom is turning up the heat at Nature Made Me, 3900 Paseo Blvd., Kansas City, MO 64127.
This isn’t your ordinary yoga class! Hip’s & Trick’s Couples Yoga is a fun and flirty night designed for couples to slow down, connect, stretch together, and enjoy each other’s energy through guided partner yoga.
🎃 HALLOWEEN COSTUMES ENCOURAGED!
Ladies, have some fun with a sexy animal-inspired, comfortable costume that still allows you to move and stretch.
Gentlemen…we love a man in uniform! 👀🔥 Think firefighter, construction worker, or another fun costume that you can comfortably move in.
🎁 SPECIAL HALLOWEEN GIFT
The FIRST 3 COUPLES TO REGISTER will receive a special gift in honor of Halloween!
🚨 ONLY 10 COUPLES AVAILABLE!
This experience is intentionally being kept small and intimate, so once the 10 spots are filled, registration is CLOSED.
💜 PRICING
$25 per couple through October 16th
$40 per couple after October 16th
Your ticket covers TWO PEOPLE, so only one ticket is needed per couple.
Come ready to move, laugh, flirt, connect, and experience your partner in a different way.
✨ Yoga
❤️ Love
😂 Laughter
🔥 Intimacy
💜 Connection
For just one night, forget the everyday routine and focus on each other.
Let’s have fun. Let’s connect. And let’s get a little extra sexy at yoga!
Fit Like Mom LLC
Heal • Move • Connect
